facts.fact: The Herald reports the electronic Government Procurement (eGP) system, launched in October 2023, was in use by 31 March 2024, with PRAZ saying it automates bid submission, evaluation and communication.
PRAZ chief executive Clever Ruswa says over 9,900 suppliers and over 380 procuring entities had registered on the eGP platform by 31 March 2024.

ZWE.note: Training mentioned is for procurement buyers and suppliers on eGP, not a civil-service digital-skills programme.
No national digital-skills programme for the public is stated; only eGP user training.
eGP is a procurement system for suppliers and buying entities, not a citizen or business service gateway.
